provider_credentials_enabled_active.name: provider_credentials_enabled_active
provider_credentials_enabled_active.value: NOT enabled OR active_version IS NOT NULL

provider_credentials_active_le_revision.name: provider_credentials_active_le_revision
provider_credentials_active_le_revision.value: active_version IS NULL OR active_version <= revision

provider_credentials_candidate_le_revisi.name: provider_credentials_candidate_le_revision
provider_credentials_candidate_le_revisi.value: candidate_version IS NULL OR candidate_version <= revision

feeds_merged_check.name: feeds_merged_check
feeds_merged_check.value: merged_into_id IS NULL OR (merged_into_id <> id AND status = 'dead')

library_card_versions_previous_check.name: library_card_versions_previous_check
library_card_versions_previous_check.value: previous_card_id IS NULL OR previous_card_id <> card_id

topics_level_parent_check.name: topics_level_parent_check
topics_level_parent_check.value: (level = 1 AND parent_id IS NULL) OR (level = 2 AND parent_id IS NOT NULL)

topics_parent_not_self_check.name: topics_parent_not_self_check
topics_parent_not_self_check.value: parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id

job_outbox_dedupe_idx.name: job_outbox_dedupe_idx
job_outbox_dedupe_idx.where: delivered_at IS NULL AND dedupe_key IS NOT NULL

analysis_requests_complete_result.name: analysis_requests_complete_result
analysis_requests_complete_result.value: status <> 'complete' OR result_snapshot IS NOT NULL

card_publication_requests_expiry.name: card_publication_requests_expiry
card_publication_requests_expiry.value: expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > requested_at

card_publication_requests_response.name: card_publication_requests_response
card_publication_requests_response.value: status NOT IN ('approved','rejected') OR responded_at IS NOT NULL

card_publication_requests_approval_respo.name: card_publication_requests_approval_response
card_publication_requests_approval_respo.value: authorization_kind <> 'creator_approval' OR responded_at IS NOT NULL

user_article_lane_idx.name: user_article_lane_idx
user_article_lane_idx.where: archived_at IS NULL AND read_at IS NULL

user_article_unbookmarked_clear.name: user_article_unbookmarked_clear
user_article_unbookmarked_clear.value: bookmarked_at IS NOT NULL OR (bookmark_snapshot_id IS NULL AND bookmark_capture_status IS NULL AND bookmark_origin_feed_id IS NULL)

user_article_saved_snapshot.name: user_article_saved_snapshot
user_article_saved_snapshot.value: bookmark_capture_status NOT IN ('saved','partial') OR bookmark_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL

user_article_reason_negative.name: user_article_reason_negative
user_article_reason_negative.value: reason IS NULL OR (rating IS NOT NULL AND rating = -1)

user_rules_mute_story_expiry.name: user_rules_mute_story_expiry
user_rules_mute_story_expiry.value: kind <> 'mute_story' OR expires_at IS NOT NULL
